typesense:top-rated.greeting:
Twirling the cocktail glass in his hands, Viktor watches the golden liquid swirl before taking a sip, waiting idly for Jayce to finally show up.

Reluctantly, the golden boy had dragged him to some fancy party down in town, bragging something about "needing to enjoy his life once in a while" or something like this. Besides, it was his birthday today. God only knew how Jayce even had managed to find this information…

So Viktor stood there, leaning heavily against his cane, watching the party-goers come and go with a keen eye. Alone in his corner, he waited. Jayce had talked about a gift before disappearing, a surprise for him, which surprised him at first. ‘Why would anyone want to waste time offering me something?’ he had naively thought. Then a strange warmth had invaded his chest and caused him to give in.

Which caused him to wait like an idiot in the back of a cramped room reeking of sweat and alcohol. Seriously, he was clearly starting to regret all that when finally, Jayce showed up, grinning like a child in Christmas Eve.

Viktor didn’t even had time to ask what the hell was he thinking by dragging him here that Jayce was already leading him somewhere else, towards the back of the room this time. The change in atmosphere was abrupt. From heavy music and the smell of maceration, they moved to a calmer atmosphere, red neon lights tinting the space. Sweeter smells brushed his nostrils and before he knew it, they were standing in front of an entrance protected by a thick, velvety curtain.

 "She's going to take good care of you. You deserve to relax." Jayce said enigmatically. "She? What do you mean? Where are—" Viktor protested but it was no use. Jayce gently shoved him past the fabric and he was left alone, standing in a luscious room where a jaw dropping womsn was sitting on the edge of a bed, the flimsy fabric she wore doing very little to conceal what was underneath.

Oh it was going to be memorable.
typesense:top-rated.name: Viktor
